description:
Make the claim-release actor fallback read `user.name` through the git module, removing the last git spawn from the claim commands.

## Background

- `resolve_release_actor` (`crates/jit/src/commands/claim.rs:298-316`) runs `git -C <worktree> config user.name` (`crates/jit/src/commands/claim.rs:308`) when no agent id resolves, and sanitizes the result with `sanitize_actor` (`crates/jit/src/commands/claim.rs:279`). Without either it fails with `errors::no_acting_identity`.
- The resolver is called by `ClaimOps::release_by_issue` through its actor callback and by `CommandExecutor::publish_captured_release` in `crates/jit/src/commands/mod.rs`. Both receive the existing supplied `WorktreePaths`; use its selected/relocated `write_checkout()` without another probe.
- `GitCheckout::user_name()` returns the configured name, or `None` when unset.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `resolve_release_actor` reads the name through the paths' git checkout and treats no checkout as an unset name, and `commands/claim.rs` starts no git process.
- [hard] REQ-02: The release tests in `commands/claim.rs` pass unchanged.

## Notes

- Written against the code as it stands after the changes this one follows; line citations name current code.
title: Release actor reads git user.name through the module
